positions.name: T-Mobile US, Inc.
positions.catalyst: BofA Securities upgraded TMUS to Buy on Mon 7/13 with a $220 price target (~17% above spot). Fresh, dated, single-name catalyst on a mega-cap liquid US common stock.
positions.driver: Defensive rotation setup: Nasdaq 100 futures -0.86% and oil +1.6% on renewed Iran headlines while the Dow is flat-to-up — money leaving high-beta tech ahead of June CPI, Fed Chair Warsh testimony and Tue big-bank earnings. TMUS is a low-beta, high-FCF telecom sitting in the sector that receives that flow, and it is NOT extended: premarket NBBO 188.00 x 188.75 vs 187.61 close = only +0.4%, so the upgrade is un-chased. Asymmetric: ~17% to the sell-side target vs a 6% hard stop.
positions.risks: Analyst-upgrade drift is a real but modest edge — the 24h upside is likely low-single-digit, not a true moonshot. A hot June CPI print or an Iran de-escalation headline that rips money back into high-beta tech would blunt the defensive bid. Telecom is rate-sensitive: a hawkish Warsh could pressure the whole group.
